title.en: What jobs are printed on Diesel 30?

description.en: Sites without stable grid power, rural and infrastructure placement, and trailer diesel pumping: 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 60 m / 180 m, aggregate 3 cm and below.
description.zh: 电网不便、农村与基建浇筑、拖式柴油泵送：4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、60 m / 180 m、骨料 3 cm 及以下。

h1.en: What jobs are printed on Diesel 30?

directAnswer.en: Three published lines: sites without stable grid power, rural and infrastructure concrete placement, and trailer-mounted diesel pumping. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 4105 diesel 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, 60 m / 180 m, maximum aggregate 3 cm and below, 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm and 2000 kg. The introduction also pairs that distance with 1 cm aggregate. Read both statements. Do not collapse them into one stone size.
directAnswer.zh: 三句已公布的话：电网供电不便的工地、农村与基建混凝土浇筑、拖式柴油泵送。邢台河北品锦机械印了 4105 柴油机 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、60 m / 180 m、最大骨料 3 cm 及以下、外形 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm、2000 kg。产品介绍还把这段距离和 1 cm 骨料写在一起。两句都要读，不要收成一个粒径。

heading.en: It is not the 17 kW house pump
heading.zh: 它不是 17 kW 的住宅泵

body.en: The rural self-built house diesel pump is 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal, 10–30 m vertical, 1–3 cm and 800 kg. Diesel 30 is a 2000 kg trailer at 15 m³/h. A short village line that fits the 17 kW window does not need Diesel 30. An infrastructure line that needs 60 m / 180 m and has no grid can start here if 15 m³/h is the output you are comparing.
body.zh: 农村自建房柴油泵是 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、1–3 cm、800 kg。柴油30是 2000 kg、15 m³/h 的拖泵。落在 17 kW 窗口里的短村镇管路不需要柴油30。需要 60 m / 180 m 又没有电网的基建管路，如果对照的输送量就是 15 m³/h，可以从这里开始。

heading.en: The next diesel step is Diesel 40

body.en: Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m at 66 kW. Stay on Diesel 30 while the pipe and the 15 m³/h cell still fit. The 1 cm note in the introduction and the 3 cm maximum cell are both on the Diesel 30 page; if your stone sits between them, ask Xingtai rather than choosing the looser number alone.
body.zh: 柴油40印的是 26 m³/h、120 m / 360 m、66 kW。管路和 15 m³/h 还盖得住时，留在柴油30。产品介绍里的 1 cm 和最大骨料格里的 3 cm 都在柴油30这一页；石子落在两者之间时，问邢台，不要单独挑更松的那个数。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Quote both the 1 cm introduction note and the 3 cm maximum cell if the stone is in between. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 如果石子在两者之间，请同时引用介绍里的 1 cm 和最大骨料格的 3 cm。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. The cell is 60 m / 180 m, horizontal / vertical.
answer.zh: 不是。格子是水平/垂直 60 m / 180 m。

answer.en: No. The diesel concrete spraying machine is a separate 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h unit.
answer.zh: 不是。柴油混凝土喷涂机是另一台 28/32 HP、5 m³/h 的设备。

question.en: Does 15 m³/h equal a day’s infrastructure pour?
question.zh: 15 m³/h 等于一天的基建浇筑量吗？

answer.zh: 不等于。它是理论输送量。
